name: agent-creator
description: Guide for creating custom agents. Use when users want to create a new agent (or update an existing agent) that operates as a specialized AI Agent instance with a defined persona, tool access, and optional skill references. Agents are defined in .agent.md files with YAML frontmatter and a system prompt body.
author: JJ Halans
triggers: what tools should my agent have
how do I structure an agent

usage.prompt: Guide the user through defining an agent's purpose, selecting its minimal tool set, scaffolding the directory with init_agent.py, writing the system prompt, and validating with quick_validate.py. Reference agent-patterns.md and tool-selection-guide.md as needed.

agentName.description: Kebab-case name for the new agent (max 64 chars).

purpose.description: Description of what the agent should do end-to-end.

outputPath.description: Directory where the agent folder should be created. Defaults to agents/.

validationResult.description: Output of quick_validate.py confirming the agent is valid.
